name: Push Notifications
description: Remote notifications service: APNs token, permission prompt, le.codes relay registration, tap/foreground routing. Pairs with the SDK's Push wrapper. The relay signs sends with the shared team key for Letary-published bundle ids (viewer + com.letary.* shells with a baked world identity, SDK 1.6.0+); other bundle ids reject at registration until per-app uploaded keys land.
